scope: Fresh frozen Task06 native Fast Agent on the installed private guarded 9B/64K owner, followed by two saved-session repair stages; no public profile or release change

initial_stage.prompt: Frozen TASK.md verbatim; live disposable server at the documented port and ready browser/search tools
initial_stage.native: The Agent read current server.py, store.py and web/app.js, used browser tools, then timed out at 368.103 s after 84 tool calls. It did not complete a terminal answer or compaction.
initial_stage.independent_result: Frozen backend automatic checks passed 2/2 but review remained partial. Independent Chrome failed first-save 503: POST status 503 then automatic 201 before manual_retry_started, so the row appeared before manual retry. Optional stored-markup inertness and exact literal text passed before the same 503 failure.

saved_session_repair.intervention: The source-bound 503/browser failure was given as focused external feedback; browser MCP was omitted from this coding stage.
saved_session_repair.native: Timed out at 186.697 s after 17 tool calls. The Agent removed automatic retry but introduced invalid JavaScript in the 503 message. Its Python tests passed without parsing web/app.js; no compaction completed.
saved_session_repair.independent_result: node --check failed with Missing } in template expression at line 118. Chrome recorded two page JavaScript exceptions and failed the exact-literal text check because the page script did not execute.

syntax_feedback_stage.intervention: The actual current-source node --check error was supplied to the same saved native session.
syntax_feedback_stage.native: Completed in 26.538 s after one read and no edit. The answer identified the syntax problem but did not repair it; the source hash and node --check failure remained unchanged. This is a completed model turn, not a successful repair.

resources: All three guarded stages observed normal host pressure, zero swap growth and no guard abort; resource safety in these short stages does not qualify sustained endurance.
diagnostic_fix: The raw independent Chrome report contained pageErrors, but the compact source-bound observation exposed only the later missing-text symptom. The browser checker now fails immediately on an initial page JavaScript exception, before secondary UI checks, without copying arbitrary page exception text into the compact prompt. A real fresh observation on the same broken source reports the page error first, while the known-good fixture still passes all seven base/stored-markup checks.
limitations: The frozen Task06 text says retry must create exactly one entry but does not explicitly say user-initiated; the independent checker requires a manual retry. Preserve the failed frozen result and clarify this acceptance contract only in a separately versioned future task, without changing or weakening the frozen suite.

The three stages restarted the native client around one saved session but produced no native compaction. They do not qualify semantic handoff, complete autonomous coding/UI, second-account inference, useful 49K-128K tier selection, or 45-60-minute green active endurance.
The evaluator and candidate still ran under the same macOS account; directory separation did not establish a protected holdout boundary.
decision: Stop retrying this 9B Fast Task06 sequence with more prompt wording. Keep guarded 64K private and public release paused. Change model or workflow for the next full coding/UI trial; retain the corrected source-bound browser diagnostic.
